0.description: Engineers from the Ferrovia neighborhood of Toledo are revered for their technical prowess… And their willingness to go beyond standard safety measures. Rumor has it that they’re working with Apollo on a very experimental piece of “transportation” to take us where the Tubes can't reach. He’s requested assistance from Raiders who understand schematics, and can keep their heads down.
0.title: Ascending The Mountain

ascending_the_mountain_project.completedDescription: The first prototype of the Ballistic Gondola is complete. Safety tests will begin shortly. Please keep any and all children, small animals, and roosters away from the Backyard.

expedition_project.description: Construct a caravan to send your Raider off on an Expedition beyond the Rust Belt.
expedition_project.longDescription: Expeditions are perilous. Your Raider will carry all their possessions into the unknown beyond the Rust Belt. In return, your next Raider gains a unique edge that lasts until the next Expedition departs.
expedition_project.name: Expedition 2

0.description: Embark on a dangerous Expedition beyond the Rust Belt.
0.name: Expedition

0.description: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan
0.name: Foundation

1.description: Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems
1.name: Core Systems

2.description: Building walls and roof, installing core systems, and defining the interior layout
2.name: Framework

3.description: Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches
3.name: Outfitting

4.description: Loading the caravan with vital supplies. Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition
4.name: Load Stage

5.description:
Your caravan is fully stocked and your Raider is ready to depart on the Expedition!

Upon departure, all items remaining in your Raider’s stash will be contributed to the Expedition, and your next Raider can earn up to five skill points based on the total value of those items.
5.name: Departure

0.description: With Frigates looming in the skies, Speranzans seek to revisit the lost art of establishing a more durable Topside presence. Document old living quarters, collect supplies and distract ARC machines to establish your own Outpost.
0.title: Sheltered Retreat

sheltered_retreat_project.completedDescription: The keys are yours! With a small piece of Topside now carved out for yourself, who knows what possibilities the future may hold?
sheltered_retreat_project.description: A first, experimental step towards establishing a Topside presence, your Outpost is a home you may truly make your own.
sheltered_retreat_project.longDescription: Conduct research, gather supplies, and safeguard the construction site to carve out your own small corner of Topside.
sheltered_retreat_project.name: Sheltered Retreat

0.description: To build Outposts that last, it is wise to draw inspiration from what few structures are still standing.
0.name: Research topside living conditions

1.description: Collect advanced materials to ensure your Outpost is resilient even in the face of an ever-looming threat.
1.name: Gather building materials

2.description: Distract and destroy ARC machines to allow for the construction efforts to take place undisturbed.
2.name: Safeguard the building site

0.description: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.
0.title: Trophy Display

trophy_display_project.completedDescription: Your trophy display is complete! All that remains is to loiter about while Speranzans gasp, gawk and linger at the indisputable evidence of your topside accomplishments.
trophy_display_project.description: Though there is no shortage of bold tales in Speranza’s cantinas, only the most devoted of Raiders have the hunting trophies to back them up.
trophy_display_project.longDescription: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.
trophy_display_project.name: Trophy Display

0.description: The earthbound machines rolling and trudging across the surface, forcing Raiders to watch their every step.
0.name: Roaming Threats

1.description: The airborne machines dominating the skies, raining peril down upon unsuspecting Raiders.
1.name: Soaring Menaces

2.description: A clear escalation of topside dangers, these machines have doled out severe punishments to overconfident Raiders.
2.name: Ferocious Foes

3.description: The vicious threats leaving behind a trail of downed Raiders; dominating their surroundings with tenacity and grit.
3.name: Dominant Dangers

4.description: The colossal foes making the earth tremble, and the epitome of big-game hunting.
4.name: Imposing Behemoths
